name: The Spring House Hotel
description: Built in 1852, the Spring House Hotel is Block Island's oldest and largest hotel — eight ways to stay, two restaurants and The Coffee Bar on a 10-acre promontory above the Atlantic Ocean.
pets: The Wickford Seaside Home is pet-friendly
amenities: Two restaurants and The Coffee Bar on site
Three on-property gardens supplying the kitchens
Seasonal complimentary service connecting the Spring House Hotel, Town Beach, Spring House in New Harbor, and the Block Island Ferry (not guaranteed)
Short walk uphill from the Old Harbor ferry
Live music on the lawn in season
faqs: Where is the Spring House Hotel?
At 52 Spring Street on Block Island, Rhode Island — a short walk uphill from the Old Harbor ferry landing.
How many ways are there to stay?

Eight: the 1852 Main Building, the Mott House, the adults-only Inn at Spring House, the Spring House in New Harbor, the Barn Apartments, the Seawinds Townhouses, the Seaside Homes, and the Cooneymus Cottage.
Where can I eat at the Spring House?
The adults-only Barn Restaurant serves dinner Wednesday through Saturday from 5 to 9 pm. The Main Restaurant and The Coffee Bar will see you in spring 2027.
One of the Seaside Homes, Wickford, is pet-friendly. Contact the hotel about other accommodations.
How do I book a room?
Book directly through the hotel's booking engine at direct-book.com/properties/SpringHouseHotelDIRECT, or call 401-466-5844.
Can I host a wedding or private event there?

Yes — the lawn above the ocean, the Seaside Veranda, the Dining Room, and Victoria's Parlor host weddings, meetings, and private events. Inquire with Molly and the events team through the event booking form.
Does the hotel sell gift cards?
Yes. Gift cards are good at the on-site restaurants and toward rooms in the Main Building, Mott House, Barn Apartments, the Inn at Spring House, and Spring House in New Harbor.
Three gardens on the hotel property are in a constant state of bloom, and their produce is reflected daily in the menus.
What are check-in and check-out times?
Hotel guest rooms: check-in after 4:00 pm, check-out by 11:00 am. Rental homes and townhomes: check-in after 5:00 pm, check-out by 10:00 am.
